title: SNP Calling and VCF Filtering Pipeline
author: M Renee Bellinger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.84fhytn

steps.title: Prepare Genome Reference
steps.instruction: Copy the genome to a working folder, unzip it, and create indices for alignment.

substeps.instruction: Copy genome.gz to working folder as genome.fasta.gz
Unzip genome.fasta.gz using gunzip
Index the genome using samtools faidx genome.fasta
Build bowtie2 index using bowtie2-build genome.fasta genome

steps.title: Map GBS Reads
steps.instruction: Map demultiplexed GBS reads to the reference genome using bowtie2. Repeat for all samples.

substeps.instruction: Run bowtie2 with settings: -q (fastq format), -p 20 (threads), --very-sensitive-local (alignment algorithm), -x genome (reference), -U [input_fastq], and -S [output_sam]

steps.title: Process Alignment Files
steps.instruction: Convert SAM files to BAM, sort reads, and filter unmapped reads for all samples in the working directory.

substeps.instruction: Convert SAM to BAM using samtools view -bS with 20 threads
Sort BAM files using samtools sort with 20 threads
Filter out unmapped reads using samtools view -h -F 4
Generate mapping statistics using samtools flagstat

steps.title: Call Variants
steps.instruction: Calculate genotype likelihoods and call variants to produce a draft VCF file.

substeps.instruction: Run samtools mpileup with settings: -gu, -f genome.fasta, -q 20, -Q 20, and output tags DP, AD, ADF, ADR, SP, INFO/AD on all mapped.bam files
Pipe output to bcftools call -m with output-type v to create draft_Taro.merged_q20Q20.vcf
Compress the resulting VCF file using gzip

steps.title: Filter Mapping Population
steps.instruction: Remove samples that are not part of the mapping population.

substeps.instruction: Use vcftools --gzvcf on draft_Taro.merged_q20Q20.vcf.gz with --keep keep_1025_230_255.txt, --recode, and --recode-INFO-all

steps.title: Remove INDELs and Nearby SNPs
steps.instruction: Filter out INDELs and SNPs located within 5 bases of an INDEL.

substeps.instruction: Remove SNPs within 5 bases of an INDEL using bcftools filter -g 5
Remove remaining indels using vcftools --remove-indels with --recode and --recode-INFO-all

steps.title: Apply Light Quality Filter
steps.instruction: Perform an initial filter for missingness, depth, and quality.

substeps.instruction: Use vcftools with settings: --max-missing 0.5, --minDP 5, --min-alleles 2, --max-alleles 2, --minQ 20, --recode, and --recode-INFO-all

steps.title: Filter Individuals by Missingness
steps.instruction: Identify and remove individuals missing more than 30% of data.

substeps.instruction: Measure individual missingness using vcftools --missing-indv
Extract individuals with missingness > 0.3 using awk and grep to create remove-indv_30perc file
Remove these individuals using vcftools --remove remove-indv_30perc while maintaining light filter settings (--max-missing 0.5, --minDP 5, --min-alleles 2, --max-alleles 2, --minQ 20)

steps.title: Filter Loci by Missingness
steps.instruction: Identify loci missing 20% or more of data.

substeps.instruction: Measure site missingness using vcftools --missing-site
Extract loci with missingness >= 0.20 using awk to create exclude_miss20p file

steps.title: Apply Stringent Filter
steps.instruction: Apply a combined stringent filter for individuals, loci, and depth.

substeps.instruction: Use vcftools with settings: --remove remove-indv_30perc, --exclude-positions exclude_miss20p, --max-missing 0.8, --minDP 8, --min-alleles 2, --max-alleles 2, --minQ 20, --recode, and --recode-INFO-all

steps.title: Filter by Minor Allele Frequency
steps.instruction: Apply a final filter based on Minor Allele Frequency (MAF).

substeps.instruction: Use vcftools with --maf 0.012, --recode, and --recode-INFO-all
